purpose: Comprehensive market & domain intelligence for Think Tank 1 (Execution Strategy) to plan 5 market research sessions

fundamental.overview: Estimates intrinsic value by examining financial health, earnings power, growth prospects, and competitive position. Core question: is the stock trading below what the business is actually worth?
dcf_template_steps: Project free cash flows for 5-10 years
Estimate terminal value (2-3% growth rate or exit multiple)
Discount back to present value using WACC
Compare intrinsic value per share to current market price
checklist: Valuation attractive relative to peers and historical range
Revenue and earnings growing or have clear catalyst
Balance sheet healthy enough to weather downturns

technical.overview: Studies price action and volume to identify trends, reversals, and optimal entry/exit points. Assumes all known information is reflected in price and historical patterns repeat. Best for timing trades and managing risk.

momentum_indicators.rsi: Range 0-100; Above 70 = overbought, Below 30 = oversold, Divergence = trend exhaustion

sentiment.overview: Gauges mood and positioning of market participants to identify mispricings. Works as contrarian tool (extremes mark turning points) and catalyst detector (sentiment shifts precede price moves).

institutional: Fund flows into/out of sector ETFs

checklist: Quantify sentiment (put/call, short interest, social volume)
Assess if price already reflects sentiment
Define expected sentiment shift and trigger

quantitative.overview: Applies mathematical and statistical models to identify mispricings, systematic edges, and risk-adjusted return opportunities. Relies on data not narrative, repeatable processes not one-off judgments.

multi_factor_approach: Score each stock on multiple factors
Rank universe, go long top decile

strategies.mean_reversion: Prices deviating from historical average tend to revert. Apply to: individual stock vs MA, valuation multiples vs history, sector vs market, volatility vs history.

momentum.price: Rank by trailing 12m return excl last month, long top/short bottom

checklist: Document backtest results (win rate, Sharpe, max drawdown)
Specify data sources and lookback period

section_6_tt_alpha_domain_strategy.executive_summary: The repository has COMPLETE infrastructure for market research but ZERO execution. All four analysis methods have detailed guides. SOP-018 defines the full workflow. 41 data sources cataloged with 16 data-collection scripts. The only missing piece is DOING THE WORK. The primary blocker is not tooling - it is the recursive pattern of building more infrastructure instead of using what exists.

quantitative.limitation: Full factor models need batch data; simplified screening possible
